name: Refinishing vs Installing New Prefinished Hardwood in Everett
title-tag: Refinish or Install New Prefinished Hardwood? Everett, WA
meta-description: Refinish your existing hardwood or install new prefinished in Everett? An honest cost and quality comparison from a contractor who does both.
post-summary: December 7, 2026 · Refinishing sound hardwood runs $3.99/sq ft; new prefinished starts around $7–$14+/sq ft before tear-out. When each one actually wins, the micro-bevel trade-off nobody mentions, and how the answer changes across Everett's mill-era homes and Silver Lake builds.
